comment: Commons files a human has looked at and refused, and why. The fetcher never chooses one of these again and the validator refuses a manifest containing one. This list exists because the automatic checks cannot see the picture: they read a title, a licence and a pixel count. Everything below passed all three and was still wrong.

files.title: File:RedDot Burger.jpg
files.reason: A glass of beer in frame and bacon in the burger. This catalogue is built for Egypt; neither belongs on a recipe card, and no rule reading a filename can see them.

files.title: File:Menemen.jpg
files.reason: An aerial photograph of the Turkish town of Menemen. The dish is named after the place, so its Commons category is mostly landscapes.

files.title: File:Warak enab.jpg
files.reason: A grape vine growing in a garden. Warak enab is the stuffed leaf, not the plant it came from.

files.title: File:Dorset Cereals muesli.jpg
files.reason: A heap of dry muesli. Raw ingredients rather than a bowl of anything, and branded packaging cereal at that.

files.title: File:Cheese kunafa at Agasi, Lajpat Nagar, Delhi (2025-10-04).jpg
files.reason: A pale flat pancake. Correctly named and not recognisable as kunafa, which is orange shredded pastry.

files.title: File:Halal Beef Lasagne and Cauliflowers - Foodilic 2024-08-12.jpg
files.reason: A canteen tray where the lasagne is a brown lump beside yellow cauliflower. Accurately titled, unappetising, and unrecognisable as the dish.

files.title: File:Levantine Lentil Soup winter Newton Massachusetts New England.jpg
files.reason: A featureless pale disc filling the frame. Nothing in it reads as soup.

files.title: File:Mushroom Risotto (4789415965).jpg
files.reason: A pan of raw mushrooms with cured meat through it. Not risotto, and the meat is not something this catalogue would serve.

files.title: File:Fried oysters with soft scrambled eggs don of Nakau.jpg
files.reason: Breaded fried oysters on rice. The title mentions scrambled eggs; the photograph is a seafood donburi.

files.title: File:Top view of cheese kunafa at Agasi, Lajpat Nagar, Delhi (2025-10-04).jpg
files.reason: A flat browned disc that reads as a potato rösti. The second candidate from the same category and the second one that is not kunafa; this recipe keeps the fallback.

files.title: File:E22011 at Ulukent.jpg
files.reason: A commuter train at Ulukent station. The first attempt was an aerial view of the town — the dish is named after the place, and its Commons category is transport and landscapes.

files.title: File:Mushroom risotto (3990739885).jpg
files.reason: Correctly a mushroom risotto, and there is a glass of red wine on the table beside it. Same disqualification as the burger.

files.title: File:Fried oysters with soft scrambled eggs bowl of Matsuya.jpg
files.reason: Fried oysters in egg on rice, again, from a different Japanese restaurant. The phrase 'soft scrambled eggs' appears on donburi menus and keeps winning the search.

files.title: File:Five Guys banana milkshake (40878734941).jpg
files.reason: A branded fast-food shake cup with the chain's logo across it. Someone else's trademark, and a takeaway cup is not a photograph of something you made.

files.title: File:Menemen Emiralem Strawberry.jpg
files.reason: A punnet of strawberries. Third attempt for this recipe and the third non-food result: the dish shares its name with a Turkish district, so its Commons category is landscapes, trains and produce. It keeps the branded fallback.

files.title: File:Asado Bogotano.jpg
files.reason: A Colombian charcoal barbecue: steak, blood sausage, plantain and potatoes, with corn cobs among them. The corn is real and the photograph is of a meat grill, not of grilled corn.

files.title: File:Gherkins and Onions.JPG
files.reason: Two jars of gherkins and pickled onions. Torshi lift is pink pickled turnip; nothing in the frame is a turnip and nothing is pink.

files.title: File:Basturma or Pastroma from Armenia 2.JPG
files.reason: An uncut block of cured basterma on a white background. The dish is eggs fried with basterma; this is the raw ingredient and there is no egg in it.

files.title: File:Chilli Garlic Chuntney and Namkeen Lassi.JPG
files.reason: A chapati with chilli chutney, garlic cloves and a glass of NAMKEEN — salted — lassi. Salted lassi is a different drink from mango lassi and there is no mango in the frame.

files.title: File:Batata bhaji and chai-Pune-Maharashtra.jpg
files.reason: A metal plate of batter-fried bhaji and green chillies, with a paper cup of chai beside it. The photograph is of the snack; the tea is an accessory in the corner.

files.title: File:Mmm... sliders and deep fried hash browns (7958927842).jpg
files.reason: Four cheeseburger sliders surrounding a pile of shredded hash browns. The hash browns are there, but a card for a potato recipe that shows four burgers promises the wrong meal.

files.title: File:And Then There Were Leftovers.jpg
files.reason: A kitchen counter of Thanksgiving leftovers: sliced turkey in the foreground, green beans, gravy, stuffing, and a small dish of mashed potato among them. The mash is a bit part.

files.title: File:Agua de Jamaica.jpg
files.reason: The hibiscus drink itself is right, and there is a dark long-necked bottle beside it that cannot be identified from the frame. In a catalogue built for Egypt an unidentifiable bottle that may be beer is not a risk worth taking; the same call was made on the burger and the mushroom risotto.

files.title: File:QAMAR AD-DIN.jpg
files.reason: A branded bottle of Kassatly Chtaura apricot syrup with the label filling the frame, beside a glass. Somebody else's trademark, and a bought concentrate rather than the drink made from the apricot sheet.

files.title: File:Cacio e pepe at trattoria in Rome.jpg
files.reason: The pasta is exactly right and there is a carafe and a stemmed glass of white wine on the table with it. Same disqualification as the mushroom risotto and the burger: this catalogue is built for Egypt.

files.title: File:Frijoles con queso,.jpg
files.reason: A blurred phone snapshot across a table: a bowl of beans with cheese being pulled out of it, several people's hands and bodies in frame. Too poor to use, and it photographs identifiable people rather than a dish.

files.title: File:Cafe Turque.jpg
files.reason: A plain white mug of black coffee on a garden table with two ring biscuits, heavily filtered. Turkish coffee is served in a small fincan with foam on top, usually beside its cezve; nothing here says which coffee this is.

files.title: File:Pasta with tomato sauce (6178622998).jpg
files.reason: Penne with AUBERGINE, basil and grated cheese, with grilled bread. A good pasta alla norma and not the Egyptian tomato-paste-and-garlic macaroni, which has none of those things.

files.title: File:Broiler-Bar.jpg
files.reason: A painted RESTAURANT SIGN reading BROILER-BAR, with a cartoon of two men over a grill. Not food at all. The strongest argument yet that a human has to look: it passed the licence, size, format, category and no-duplicate checks without difficulty.

files.title: File:Berenjenas con Miel.jpg
files.reason: Spanish berenjenas con miel — battered aubergine drizzled with honey. A real dish and a different one; the Egyptian version is fried plain and dressed with garlic and vinegar.

files.title: File:Samosas, snack food at Wikipedia's 16th Birthday celebration in Chittagong (01).jpg
files.reason: Fried samosas with a green potato-and-pea filling, photographed at an event. The shape is right and the filling visibly is not: this recipe is cheese sambousek.

files.title: File:GD 廣東 Guangdong 河源市 HeYuan 越王大道 YueWang Avenue Double Tree by Hilton Hotel Open Cafe n Restaurant 早餐 breakfast food buffet scrambled egg with tomato April 2026 N13P.jpg
files.reason: Two hotel buffet chafing pots on a service counter with their labels showing, one of them scrambled egg with tomato. A buffet line is not a plate of food.

files.title: File:Ελληνικό Σουβλάκι - panoramio.jpg
files.reason: Skewers on a charcoal grill whose meat is pale, marbled and pink — Greek souvlaki is traditionally PORK, and nothing in the frame rules it out. A catalogue built for Egypt does not gamble on that.

files.title: File:Bartley's.jpg
files.reason: A diner plate of corn dogs and sweet potato fries with a small ramekin of slaw at the edge, plus a cola. The slaw is a garnish in its own photograph.

files.title: File:AUD9 Buffet - Green Pepper (2110184894).jpg
files.reason: A restaurant buffet line of chafing dishes with a basket of naan in the foreground. Blurred, cluttered, and a photograph of a buffet rather than of bread.

files.title: File:Chicken katsu curry rice - Korpan.jpg
files.reason: A katsu cutlet sliced over rice and flooded with Japanese curry sauce. The recipe is the crumbed cutlet alone; the curry is most of the plate and most of the promise.

files.title: File:Syrian apricot paste 01.jpg
files.reason: Shrink-wrapped branded slabs of apricot paste on a market shelf with price tags. Packaging again, from a different angle — the second qamar el din candidate and the second that photographs the product rather than the drink.

files.title: File:Pickled food.JPG
files.reason: A dish of pickled cucumbers, green chillies, radish and a pickled lemon. Levantine mixed pickles; the dish is pink pickled TURNIP and there is no turnip in the frame.

files.title: File:Arabaga.jpg
files.reason: A branded tin of Arabağa Türk kahvesi standing on a counter. Somebody else's trademark, and a photograph of coffee grounds in a can rather than of coffee.

files.title: File:Refried Black Beans (4646266085).jpg
files.reason: A well-photographed mound of BLACK beans. The recipe is built on kidney beans and the colour is the one thing a user checks against the picture.

files.title: File:Roat - A Punjabi dish served with daliya(cracked wheat porridge).jpg
files.reason: A polystyrene bowl of Punjabi daliya with a piece of cake, photographed on an office desk beside a keyboard and a pair of glasses. The wheat porridge is close, the dish and the setting are not.

files.title: File:American Breakfast (28188218105).jpg
files.reason: A café breakfast table: a basket of croissants, a cappuccino, eggs on muffins and an omelette, with two hash brown triangles as a side on each plate.

files.title: File:Akha cuisine Mochue tong-uh.JPG
files.reason: An Akha herb potato mash, dim and heavily green. Recognisably mashed potato and recognisably a different dish from buttery mash.

files.title: File:Banarasi Lassi.jpg
files.reason: A clay cup of thick white Banarasi lassi topped with pistachio and saffron. A beautiful photograph of a lassi with no mango in it.

files.title: File:Kolkata Wayside Tea Stall.jpg
files.reason: A street vendor's hands pouring chai from a pan beside a grimy burner. It is chai, and it is a process photograph of a stall rather than a cup of tea.

files.title: File:Chickens in market.jpg
files.reason: Whole plucked chickens hanging in a butcher's window beside the scale. Raw poultry for sale, not chicken livers, not a cooked dish.

files.title: File:Aho ji nashta kijie.jpg
files.reason: A breakfast tray where a white-bread sev sandwich is as prominent as the parathas. The competing food is unrelated to the dish rather than something served with it.

files.title: File:020170717 Polish - english breakfast in London.jpg
files.reason: A full English breakfast: bacon, pork sausages, hash browns and an omelette, with the beans pushed to one edge. Pork in frame and the dish is not the subject.

files.title: File:Eggs with cheese, mushrooms, and basil.jpg
files.reason: A dark, blurred home snapshot on a paper towel: American scrambled eggs under shredded cheese and sriracha, with mushrooms and spinach. Not eggs with Egyptian white cheese, and unusable quality besides.

files.title: File:Tomato and egg soup.jpg
files.reason: Chinese tomato-and-egg SOUP in a broth bowl. Beid bel tamatem is eggs fried into tomatoes in a pan; a thin soup is a different dish. Second refusal for this slug.

files.title: File:Bento of tonkatsu, jiaozi, California Rolls and rice with black sesame.jpg
files.reason: A takeaway styrofoam bento sitting on a computer keyboard, and the cutlet is tonkatsu - pork. Second refusal for this slug.

files.title: File:A traditional coleslaw with added honey, mixed nuts, dried apricots & mustard seed for serving.JPG
files.reason: A murky kitchen snapshot: the used mixing bowl and a smeared spoon fill the top of the frame and an unidentifiable dark bottle sits at the edge. Second refusal for this slug.

files.title: File:Egg curry pic.jpg
files.reason: An over-processed extreme close-up of a pan. The saturation is pushed so hard the egg is barely findable; nobody would read this as a dish.

files.title: File:Rew13c05-745a Bread Pudding.JPG
files.reason: Western raisin bread pudding on a plate. Eish el saraya is rusk soaked in sugar syrup under a layer of ashta and pistachio, with no raisins and no baked sponge.

files.title: File:BUTTER NON with GOBI PANEER + VEG MIX.jpg
files.reason: A 'Retrica' app watermark burned into the bottom-right corner, over a dim purple-cast thali of two curries. Second refusal for this slug.

files.title: File:Black rice onigiri by Adonis Chen in Hsinchu.jpg
files.reason: The rice ball is still inside its convenience-store plastic wrapper and out of focus. Packaging, and the shape that makes an onigiri recognisable is hidden.

files.title: File:Proper Panzanella Salad, Jamies Italian, Leeds.jpg
files.reason: A tall glass of amber liquid at the top edge of the frame, from a restaurant chain's table, that cannot be confirmed as anything but beer. The same rule that refused the burger photograph applies when the drink is unidentifiable.

files.title: File:Noura - Lebanese sweets.jpg
files.reason: A Lebanese sweet-shop table where the front plate is halawet el jibn - cream-filled semolina rolls. Qatayef are folded stuffed pancakes; this is a different sweet entirely.

files.title: File:Oreochromis-niloticus-Nairobi.JPG
files.reason: A live Nile tilapia swimming in an aquarium. The species is right and the food is absent.

files.title: File:Beverages in Coke bottles.JPG
files.reason: A street vendor's shelf of refilled PET bottles with commercial labels and a phone number printed across them. Commercial packaging, and not something anybody made at home.

files.title: File:Roasted chicken leg piece-MB20.jpg
files.reason: Two chicken leg quarters with parallel grill bars charred across them, on a bright green plastic plate. This recipe is a WHOLE bird roasted breast-down in an oven; the photograph is jointed tandoori-style grilled chicken, and the difference is the first thing anyone would see. Promoted in error on a first pass and reversed on a second look at full size — the thumbnail hid the grill marks.

files.title: File:Black eyed peas food.jpg
files.reason: A dense mass of RAW DRIED black-eyed peas filling the frame. Raw produce, not a cooked dish — the same class as the heap of dry muesli already on this list.

files.title: File:Freshly Picked Green Fava Beans from a Libyan Farm.jpg
files.reason: Two hands holding freshly picked green fava bean PODS under an olive tree. The ingredient on the farm, not the dish in a pan.

files.title: File:Chicken Drumsticks on a Grill.jpg
files.reason: Two dozen RAW marinated drumsticks laid out on a cold grill rack, skin still pink. This is the prep step, not the meal, and raw poultry on a recipe card is worse than no photograph.

files.title: File:Chinese squab.jpg
files.reason: Chinese roast squab: deep lacquered mahogany skin, dipping sauces, an unidentifiable amber drink behind it. Egyptian hamam mahshi is a small pale-gold bird stuffed with rice or freek. Same bird, different cuisine's dish.

files.title: File:Osso buco, Breckenheim.jpg
files.reason: Osso buco — a cross-cut veal shank on saffron risotto with a wine glass and a bread basket in frame. Egyptian moza is a whole braised shank; this is the Milanese dish, and the risotto is half the plate.

files.title: File:Vegetable udon noodle soup.jpg
files.reason: A pan of Japanese udon noodle soup: wheat noodles, broccoli, mushrooms and courgette in a soy-brown broth. Not an Egyptian vegetable soup, and two of its main components are not in this recipe.

files.title: File:Simit vendor next to checkpoint, Nicosia.jpg
files.reason: Shot through a shop window in Nicosia. Street reflections cover most of the frame — a bystander's face, exchange-bureau signage, and beer-brand parasols — and the bread is behind glass.

files.title: File:Asian glazed chicken on fried rice (6107408438).jpg
files.reason: Glazed chicken thighs on egg fried rice with gyoza and a ramekin of soy dipping sauce. An Asian plate, not chicken cooked on top of the rice.

files.title: File:Beef stroganoff with pasta.jpg
files.reason: A dim, orange-cast close-up where egg noodles fill most of the frame and the beef is barely findable. The recipe has no pasta in it, and the photograph is too murky to read as food.

files.title: File:Baked potato with baked beans and cheese - The Verandah 2026-08-25.jpg
files.reason: A jacket potato buried under BAKED BEANS and grated cheese, with a side salad and a juice jug. The beans are half the dish and this recipe does not contain them.

files.title: File:Chicken corn soup.jpg
files.reason: A beige pool in a red bowl on a checked tablecloth, with a glass of amber liquid, a plastic bottle and somebody's arm in frame. Neither the chicken nor the corn is visible.

files.title: File:Mon Plaisir, Covent Garden, London (3717184145).jpg
files.reason: A restaurant tureen of pale green soup with a cream quenelle and croutons, on a doily, with a wine glass behind. The file names a Covent Garden restaurant rather than a dish, so the identity cannot be confirmed — and neither the cream nor the croutons are in this recipe.

files.title: File:Potato and egg curry.jpg
files.reason: An Indian potato-and-egg curry in a big aluminium pot on a dirty outdoor surface. Turmeric gravy and fried egg balls; not the Egyptian pan of potatoes with eggs broken over them.

files.title: File:Fried Artichoke Hearts.JPG
files.reason: A takeaway box of deep-fried BATTERED artichoke hearts — golden dough lumps in which no artichoke is visible. `Ardi shoki bel zeit` is hearts stewed in olive oil with lemon; batter and a deep fryer are the opposite preparation, and nothing in the frame reads as an artichoke.

files.title: File:Roasted roach.jpg
files.reason: Four whole pan-fried roach on a black tray. No potatoes anywhere, nothing baked, and near-identical in composition to the fried-fish photograph promoted for `samak-makli` — two cards showing the same tray of fried fish.

files.title: File:Beef shawarma Rice servings.jpg
files.reason: Wrap pinwheels stood on end in a row, each capped with a blob of mayonnaise and a squirt of cheese sauce, on a granite worktop with spilled sauce and a stray lettuce leaf beside them. Shawarma is meat carved off a vertical spit into bread; this is a cold buffet platter.

files.title: File:Aspic ouvert - 1.JPG
files.reason: A sliced ASPIC terrine — halved egg and ham set in amber gelatine — photographed against a French mineral-water bottle. Not boiled eggs, not cumin, not the dish, and the pork makes it unusable here regardless.

files.title: File:Stuffed roast chicken.jpg
files.reason: A plain herbed roast chicken on a floral tablecloth with carving knife and fork. No stuffing is visible, so the one thing that makes the dish itself is absent — and the skin is pale with pink-tinged juice pooling on the plate, which is the wrong picture to put beside a recipe whose endpoint is 74 °C.

files.title: File:Kari Ikan Sri Lanka.jpg
files.reason: A Sri Lankan fish-HEAD curry: the head fills the middle of the bowl, eye socket and gill plate forward, with crab claws and okra around it, shot on a tiled floor with a plastic spoon. Neither the dish that was searched for nor something a cook would want on a card.

files.title: File:Beef Kebab and Pita.jpg
files.reason: The photograph is a MINCED-meat seekh kebab — one long hand-moulded cylinder, rippled where the fingers pressed it. The candidate is cubed beef on a skewer, which is what distinguishes kabab from kofta in the first place. Good picture, wrong dish, and the honest fix is a different photograph rather than a rewritten candidate.

files.title: File:Blue crab at a USA market.jpg
files.reason: A market tray of RAW LIVE blue crabs. Raw produce on ice rather than a cooked dish, the same class as the heap of dry muesli and the dried black-eyed peas already on this list.

files.title: File:Rogan josh-dal makhani-lacha parantha.jpg
files.reason: A restaurant combination plate: a small bowl of rogan josh beside a second bowl of dal makhani, a stack of parathas and an onion salad in a papad cup, with glassware in two corners. Two of the three dishes in frame are not this recipe.

files.title: File:Lamb shank with curry.jpg
files.reason: A lamb shank standing in a bright orange CURRY sauce, plated in a restaurant with copper serving dishes behind it. Egyptian moza is a shank braised in tomato and onion; this is an Indian curry wearing the same cut of meat.

files.title: File:Shrimp pasta.jpg
files.reason: A camera DATE STAMP is burned into the bottom of the frame as a black bar reading 11/06/2016, 12:29:35 EST. Nothing can crop that off without losing the pasta, and a card cannot carry someone's camera settings.

files.title: File:Chuletillas-El-Mazuco.jpg
files.reason: Spanish chuletillas: six small chops burnt to the bone with a pile of CHIPS heaped over them, on a paper café tablecloth strewn with crumbs. The chips are a second dish the recipe does not contain and they occupy the top third of the plate; what is left reads as bone and char.

files.title: File:Ary-7sowa.jpg
files.reason: Not a served dish at all — two people's hands, a battered aluminium saucepan of pale gruel, a ladle and a spoon, shot in a dark room over a crumb-covered tablecloth. A process snapshot, and too dim to read as food.
